name: Preem Gothenburg refinery hydrotreater co-processing, Sweden (Preem/Topsoe HydroFlex)
description: 6,600 bpd hydrotreater co-processing 85% renewable feedstock (achieved May 2021); first company in the world to produce renewable diesel at refinery scale through co-processing

sources.note: Topsoe news, May 2021 (85% co-processing, 6,600 bpd); VAROPreem (first at refinery scale); Honeywell/UOP pyrolysis-oil co-processing trial Sep 2021; read 2026-10-28
